title: Guha gets a boat ready
introduction: As per instructions of Rama, Guha gets a boat ready. Sumantra requests Rama to take him as a personal attendant to the forest, but Rama declines his offer and after reasoning with him, sends him back to Ayodhya. Rama and Lakshmana matted their hair with the latex of a banyan tree procured by Guha. On reaching the middle of the stream, Sita offers prayers to Mother Ganga (the deity presiding over the stream) and after crossing the river, all the three halt for the night at the foot of a tree.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अयोध्य काण्डे द्विपंचाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 52nd chapter in the AyodhyaKanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
प्रभातायाम् तु शर्वर्याम् पृथु वृक्षा महा यशाः |
उवाच रामः सौमित्रिम् लक्ष्मणम् शुभ लक्षणम्
verses.iast:
prabhātāyām tu śarvaryām pṛthu vṛkṣā mahā yaśāḥ |
uvāca rāmaḥ saumitrim lakṣmaṇam śubha lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: That night having given way to dawn, the illustrious Rama with a broad chest spoke (as follows) to Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra and who was endowed with auspicious signs :

glosses.meaning: the man with a broad chest

verses.devanagari:
भास्कर उदय कालो अयम् गता भगवती निशा |
असौ सुकृष्णो विहगः कोकिलः तात कूजति
verses.iast:
bhāskara udaya kālo ayam gatā bhagavatī niśā |
asau sukṛṣṇo vihagaḥ kokilaḥ tāta kūjati
verses.translation: "Oh, dear brother! This is the hour of sunrise. The auspicious night has departed. That bird of dark plumage, the cuckoo, is singing."

glosses.meaning: is the hour of sunrise. bhagavatii = The auspicious

verses.devanagari:
बर्हिणानाम् च निर्घोषः श्रूयते नदताम् वने |
तराम जाह्नवीम् सौम्य शीघ्रगाम् सागरम् गमाम्
verses.iast:
barhiṇānām ca nirghoṣaḥ śrūyate nadatām vane |
tarāma jāhnavīm saumya śīghragām sāgaram gamām
verses.translation: "Oh, good brother! Hear the cries of peacocks resounding in the forest. Let us cross the swift-flowing Ganga River that gushes to the sea."
notes: --***-The river Ganga, when brought down from heaven by the austerities of Emperor Bhagiratha, followed the latter to the subterranean regions in order to consecrate the remains of his great grand uncles. In its course, it inundated the sacrificial ground of king Jahnu, who in his anger, drank up its waters. But the gods and sages and particularly Bhagiratha appeased his anger and he consented to release the waters through his ears. The river is thereafter regarded as his daughter.

verses.devanagari:
विज्ञाय रामस्य वचः सौमित्रिर् मित्र नन्दनः |
गुहम् आमन्त्र्य सूतम् च सो अतिष्ठद् भ्रातुर् अग्रतः
verses.iast:
viGYāya rāmasya vacaḥ saumitrir mitra nandanaḥ |
guham āmantrya sūtam ca so atiṣṭhad bhrātur agrataḥ
verses.translation: Lakshmana, the delight of his friends, having understood the words of Rama, called Guha as well as Sumantra and stood in front of his brother.

verses.devanagari:
स तु रामस्य वचनम् निशम्य प्रतिगृह्य च |
स्थपतिस्तूर्णमाहुय सचिवानिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa tu rāmasya vacanam niśamya pratigṛhya ca |
sthapatistūrṇamāhuya sacivānidamabravīt
verses.translation: Hearing the command of Rama, Guha quickly received it, invited his ministers and spoke to them as follows:

verses.devanagari:
अस्य वाहनसम्युक्ताम् कर्णग्राहवतीम् शुभाम् |
सुप्रताराम् दृढाम् तीर्खे शीग्रम् नावमुपाहर
verses.iast:
asya vāhanasamyuktām karṇagrāhavatīm śubhām |
supratārām dṛḍhām tīrkhe śīgram nāvamupāhara
verses.translation: "Let a beautiful boat that is solidly constructed, sails well and a helmsman in it, be brought to the bank to carry this hero across!"

glosses.meaning: and having a helmsman in it

verses.devanagari:
तम् निशम्य समादेशम् गुहामात्यगणो महान् |
उपोह्य रुचिराम् नावम् गुहाय प्रत्यवेदयत्
verses.iast:
tam niśamya samādeśam guhāmātyagaṇo mahān |
upohya rucirām nāvam guhāya pratyavedayat
verses.translation: Hearing that command, the chief minister of King Guha brought a charming boat to the bank and reported the matter to Guha.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सप्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा गुहो राघवमब्रवीत् |
उपस्थितेयम् नौर्देव भूयः किम् करवाणि ते
verses.iast:
tataḥ saprāJṇjalirbhūtvā guho rāghavamabravīt |
upasthiteyam naurdeva bhūyaḥ kim karavāṇi te
verses.translation: Then, Guha with folded hands spoke to Rama as follows: "Oh, Lord! Here, the boat has arrived. What more can I do for you?"

verses.devanagari:
तवामरसुतप्रख्य तर्तुम् सागरगाम् नदीम् |
नौरियम् पुरुषव्याग्र! ताम् त्वमारोह सुव्रत!
verses.iast:
tavāmarasutaprakhya tartum sāgaragām nadīm |
nauriyam puruśhavyāgra! tām tvamāroha suvrata!
verses.translation: "Oh, tiger among men! Oh, Rama resembling a son of divinity! Here is the boat for you to cross the river, which flows into the sea. Oh, virtuous one! (Pray) get into it."

glosses.itrans: Rama resembling a son of divinity! iyam
glosses.iast: Rama resembling a son of divinity! iyam
glosses.devanagari: Rअम रेसेम्ब्लिन्ग् अ सोन् ओf दिविनित्य्! इयं

glosses.meaning: which flows into the sea. suvrata = Oh

verses.devanagari:
अथोवाच महातेजा रामो गुहमिदम् वचः |
कृतकामोऽस्मि भवता शीघ्रमारोप्यतामिति
verses.iast:
athovāca mahātejā rāmo guhamidam vacaḥ |
kṛtakāmo'smi bhavatā śīghramāropyatāmiti
verses.translation: Then, Rama with great splendor, spoke to Guha as follows: "My desire has been accomplished by you. Let us embark with all speed."

glosses.meaning: one whose desire has been accomplished
by you. aaropyataam = Let us embark shiighram = with speed".

verses.devanagari:
ततः कलापान् सम्नह्य खड्गौ बद्ध्वा च धन्विनौ |
जग्मतुर् येन तौ गन्गाम् सीतया सह राघवौ
verses.iast:
tataḥ kalāpān samnahya khaḍgau baddhvā ca dhanvinau |
jagmatur yena tau gangām sītayā saha rāghavau
verses.translation: Having equipped themselves with a quiver each with arrows, fastening their swords and armed with their bows, Rama and Lakshmana, with Sita, proceeded towards the river of Ganga.

verses.devanagari:
रामम् एव तु धर्मज्ञम् उपगम्य विनीतवत् |
किम् अहम् करवाणि इति सूतः प्रान्जलिर् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
rāmam eva tu dharmaGYam upagamya vinītavat |
kim aham karavāṇi iti sūtaḥ prānjalir abravīt
verses.translation: Sumantra joining his palms in humility, approached Rama who knew what is right and said, "What shall I do?"

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽब्रवीद्दाशरथिः सुमन्त्रम् |
स्पृशन् करेणोत्तमदक्षिणेन |
सुमन्त्र शीघ्रम् पुनरेव याहि |
राज्ञः सकाशे भवचाप्रमत्तः
verses.iast:
tato'bravīddāśarathiḥ sumantram |
spṛśan kareṇottamadakśiṇena |
sumantra śīghram punareva yāhi |
rājJṇaḥ sakāśe bhavacāpramattaḥ
verses.translation: Touching Sumantra with his auspicious right hand, Rama then said: "Oh, Sumantra! Return quickly to the king's presence and be attentive in serving him."

verses.devanagari:
निवर्तस्व इति उवाच एनम् एतावद्द् हि कृतम् मम |
रथम् विहाय पद्भ्याम् तु गमिष्यामि महावनम्
verses.iast:
nivartasva iti uvāca enam etāvadd hi kṛtam mama |
ratham vihāya padbhyām tu gamiśhyāmi mahāvanam
verses.translation: "Go now, that your service to me has been completed. Abandoning the chariot, I shall go on foot to the mighty forest," Rama said.

glosses.meaning: to me. nivartasya = Return. gamishhyaami = I shall go

verses.devanagari:
आत्मानम् तु अभ्यनुज्ञातम् अवेक्ष्य आर्तः स सारथिः |
सुमन्त्रः पुरुष व्याघ्रम् ऐक्ष्वाकम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
ātmānam tu abhyanuGYātam avekṣya ārtaḥ sa sārathiḥ |
sumantraḥ puruṣa vyāghram aikṣvākam idam abravīt
verses.translation: Finding himself dismissed, Sumantra the charioteer was distressed and spoke to Rama, the tiger among men, as follows:

verses.devanagari:
न अतिक्रान्तम् इदम् लोके पुरुषेण इह केनचित् |
तव सभ्रातृ भार्यस्य वासः प्राकृतवद् वने
verses.iast:
na atikrāntam idam loke puruṣeṇa iha kenacit |
tava sabhrātṛ bhāryasya vāsaḥ prākṛtavad vane
verses.translation: "None in the world has had to suffer such a fate as yourself; that you should have to dwell in the forest with your brother and your consort as if you were an ordinary man!"

glosses.meaning: with your brother and your consort. idam = This

verses.devanagari:
न मन्ये ब्रह्म चर्ये अस्ति स्वधीते वा फल उदयः |
मार्दव आर्जवयोः वा अपि त्वाम् चेद् व्यसनम् आगतम्
verses.iast:
na manye brahma carye asti svadhīte vā phala udayaḥ |
mārdava ārjavayoḥ vā api tvām ced vyasanam āgatam
verses.translation: "I think that there is no reward in leading a life of religious student or in studying religious scriptures or even in cultivating tenderness and straight forwardness, when adversity has come to you."

glosses.meaning: in leading a life of religious student
or even in cultivating tenderness and strait forwardness

verses.devanagari:
सह राघव वैदेह्या भ्रात्रा चैव वने वसन् |
त्वम् गतिम् प्राप्स्यसे वीर त्रीम्ल् लोकांस् तु जयन्न् इव
verses.iast:
saha rāghava vaidehyā bhrātrā caiva vane vasan |
tvam gatim prāpsyase vīra trīml lokāṃs tu jayann iva
verses.translation: "Oh, heroic Rama! Living in the forest along with Sita and your brother, you will obtain the same position as one who has conquered the three worlds."

verses.devanagari:
वयम् खलु हता राम ये तया अपि उपवन्चिताः |
कैकेय्या वशम् एष्यामः पापाया दुह्ख भागिनः
verses.iast:
vayam khalu hatā rāma ye tayā api upavancitāḥ |
kaikeyyā vaśam eṣyāmaḥ pāpāyā duhkha bhāginaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! We are actually ruined, in that, disappointed in our hopes by you too, we shall fall under the sway of Kaikeyi the sinful woman and reap the suffering."

verses.devanagari:
इति ब्रुवन्न् आत्म समम् सुमन्त्रः सारथिस् तदा |
दृष्ट्वा दुर गतम् रामम् दुह्ख आर्तः रुरुदे चिरम्
verses.iast:
iti bruvann ātma samam sumantraḥ sārathis tadā |
dṛṣṭvā dura gatam rāmam duhkha ārtaḥ rurude ciram
verses.translation: Sumantra the charioteer thus speaking, wept for a long time, stricken with grief, seeing Rama, equal to his soul, departing to a distance.

verses.devanagari:
ततः तु विगते बाष्पे सूतम् स्पृष्ट उदकम् शुचिम् |
रामः तु मधुरम् वाक्यम् पुनः पुनर् उवाच तम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tu vigate bāṣpe sūtam spṛṣṭa udakam śucim |
rāmaḥ tu madhuram vākyam punaḥ punar uvāca tam
verses.translation: Then, Rama again and again spoke these sweet words as follows to that charioteer, whose tears got dried up and who had sipped some water and got himself purified:

verses.devanagari:
इक्ष्वाकूणाम् त्वया तुल्यम् सुहृदम् न उपलक्षये |
यथा दशरथो राजा माम् न शोचेत् तथा कुरु
verses.iast:
ikṣvākūṇām tvayā tulyam suhṛdam na upalakṣaye |
yathā daśaratho rājā mām na śocet tathā kuru
verses.translation: "I do not see any one who is as great a friend of the Ikshvakus as you are. (Pray) act in such a way that king Dasaratha may not lament about me"

glosses.meaning: for the kings of Ikshvaku dynasty. kuru = Act

verses.devanagari:
शोक उपहत चेताः च वृद्धः च जगती पतिः |
काम भार अवसन्नः च तस्मात् एतत् ब्रवीमि ते
verses.iast:
śoka upahata cetāḥ ca vṛddhaḥ ca jagatī patiḥ |
kāma bhāra avasannaḥ ca tasmāt etat bravīmi te
verses.translation: "The king, his mind afflicted with grief, is aged as well. He is pressed down by a burden of passion. Hence, I tell you this."

glosses.meaning: is aged as well. Kaamabhaaraavasannashcha = (He is) pressed down by a burden of passion. tasmaat = for that reason

verses.devanagari:
यद् यद् आज्ञापयेत् किंचित् स महात्मा मही पतिः |
कैकेय्याः प्रिय काम अर्थम् कार्यम् तत् अविकान्क्षया
verses.iast:
yad yad āGYāpayet kiṃcit sa mahātmā mahī patiḥ |
kaikeyyāḥ priya kāma artham kāryam tat avikānkṣayā
verses.translation: "What so ever act that high-soled emperor may enjoin you to do, with intent to oblige the desire of Kaikeyi, it is to be done unhesitatingly."

glosses.meaning: with intent to oblige the desire

verses.devanagari:
एतत् अर्थम् हि राज्यानि प्रशासति नर ईश्वराः |
यद् एषाम् सर्व कृत्येषु मनो न प्रतिहन्यते
verses.iast:
etat artham hi rājyāni praśāsati nara īśvarāḥ |
yad eṣām sarva kṛtyeṣu mano na pratihanyate
verses.translation: "The kings indeed rule the states with this end in view that their will may not be frustrated in any undertaking."

verses.devanagari:
यद्यथा स महा राजो न अलीकम् अधिगच्चति |
न च ताम्यति दुह्खेन सुमन्त्र कुरु तत् तथा
verses.iast:
yadyathā sa mahā rājo na alīkam adhigaccati |
na ca tāmyati duhkhena sumantra kuru tat tathā
verses.translation: "Oh, Sumantra! Carry out everything in such a way that the said emperor neither finds it unpleasing nor gets tormented by grief."

verses.devanagari:
अदृष्ट दुह्खम् राजानम् वृद्धम् आर्यम् जित इन्द्रियम् |
ब्रूयाः त्वम् अभिवाद्य एव मम हेतोर् इदम् वचः
verses.iast:
adṛṣṭa duhkham rājānam vṛddham āryam jita indriyam |
brūyāḥ tvam abhivādya eva mama hetor idam vacaḥ
verses.translation: "Only after performing respectful salutation to the old and venerable king, who has never known suffering and who has subdued his senses, you tell these words to him on my behalf."

glosses.meaning: and who has subdued his senses

verses.devanagari:
न एव अहम् अनुशोचामि लक्ष्मणो न च मैथिली |
अयोध्यायाः च्युताः च इति वने वत्स्यामह इति वा (महेति!)
verses.iast:
na eva aham anuśocāmi lakṣmaṇo na ca maithilī |
ayodhyāyāḥ cyutāḥ ca iti vane vatsyāmaha iti vā (maheti!)
verses.translation: "Indeed neither I nor Lakshmana and Sita grieve for having moved from Ayodhya or that we are going to dwell in a forest."

glosses.meaning: or that we are going to dwell

verses.devanagari:
चतुर् दशसु वर्षेषु निवृत्तेषु पुनः पुनः |
लक्ष्मणम् माम् च सीताम् च द्रक्ष्यसि क्षिप्रम् आगतान्
verses.iast:
catur daśasu varṣeṣu nivṛtteṣu punaḥ punaḥ |
lakṣmaṇam mām ca sītām ca drakṣyasi kṣipram āgatān
verses.translation: "After completing fourteen years, you will once more see Lakshmana, myself and Sita too returned apace from the forest."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्त्वा तु राजानम् मातरम् च सुमन्त्र मे |
अन्याः च देवीः सहिताः कैकेयीम् च पुनः पुनः
आरोग्यम् ब्रूहि कौसल्याम् अथ पाद अभिवन्दनम् |
सीताया मम च आर्यस्य वचनाल् लक्ष्मणस्य च
verses.iast:
evam uktvā tu rājānam mātaram ca sumantra me |
anyāḥ ca devīḥ sahitāḥ kaikeyīm ca punaḥ punaḥ
ārogyam brūhi kausalyām atha pāda abhivandanam |
sītāyā mama ca āryasya vacanāl lakṣmaṇasya ca
verses.translation: "Oh,Sumantra! This is what you should say to the king, my mother, all other queens and Kaikeyi. Tell Kausalya again and again that I am keeping good health. Thereafter, convey salutations at her feet on behalf of Sita as well as myself and Lakshmana the faithful man."

verses.devanagari:
ब्रूयाः च हि महा राजम् भरतम् क्षिप्रम् आनय |
आगतः च अपि भरतः स्थाप्यो नृप मते पदे
verses.iast:
brūyāḥ ca hi mahā rājam bharatam kṣipram ānaya |
āgataḥ ca api bharataḥ sthāpyo nṛpa mate pade
verses.translation: "Tell our salutations to the emperor too. Bring Bharata quickly. After his arrival, Bharata may be installed in the position, as desired by the king."

glosses.meaning: to the emperor also. anaya = Bring

verses.devanagari:
भरतम् च परिष्वज्य यौवराज्ये अभिषिच्य च |
अस्मत् सम्तापजम् दुह्खम् न त्वाम् अभिभविष्यति
verses.iast:
bharatam ca pariṣvajya yauvarājye abhiṣicya ca |
asmat samtāpajam duhkham na tvām abhibhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "When you embrace Bharata and install him in the office of the Prince Regent, the agony caused by the repentance felt by you on our account will not overpower you."

glosses.meaning: in the office of the Prince Regent
caused by the remorse felt by you on our account

verses.devanagari:
भरतः च अपि वक्तव्यो यथा राजनि वर्तसे |
तथा मातृषु वर्तेथाः सर्वास्व् एव अविशेषतः
verses.iast:
bharataḥ ca api vaktavyo yathā rājani vartase |
tathā mātṛṣu vartethāḥ sarvāsv eva aviśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "Bharata too is to be told thus: "Treat without distinction all your mothers with the same regard as you behave towards the king."

verses.devanagari:
यथा च तव कैकेयी सुमित्रा च अविशेषतः |
तथैव देवी कौसल्या मम माता विशेषतः
verses.iast:
yathā ca tava kaikeyī sumitrā ca aviśeṣataḥ |
tathaiva devī kausalyā mama mātā viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "As is your affection for Kaikeyi, so let it be for Sumitra and also the divine Kausalya, my mother"

verses.devanagari:
तातस्य प्रियकामेन यौवराज्यमपेक्षता |
लोकयोरुभयोः शक्यम् त्वया यत्सुखमेधितुम्
verses.iast:
tātasya priyakāmena yauvarājyamapekśatā |
lokayorubhayoḥ śakyam tvayā yatsukhamedhitum
verses.translation: "If you accept the princely kingdom with an intent to please our father, it will be possible for you to enhance happiness in both the worlds (in this world and the next)."

verses.devanagari:
निवर्त्यमानो रामेण सुमन्त्रः शोक कर्शितः |
तत् सर्वम् वचनम् श्रुत्वा स्नेहात् काकुत्स्थम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
nivartyamāno rāmeṇa sumantraḥ śoka karśitaḥ |
tat sarvam vacanam śrutvā snehāt kākutstham abravīt
verses.translation: Sumantra, who was being sent back by Rama, was agonized with grief after hearing the whole of that discourse and affectionately spoke to Rama as follows:

verses.devanagari:
यद् अहम् न उपचारेण ब्रूयाम् स्नेहात् अविक्लवः |
भक्तिमान् इति तत् तावद् वाक्यम् त्वम् क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
yad aham na upacāreṇa brūyām snehāt aviklavaḥ |
bhaktimān iti tat tāvad vākyam tvam kṣantum arhasi
verses.translation: "If I spoke to you fearlessly in a friendly tone without following courteousness, you ought to forgive my mode of expression, considering me as your devotee"

verses.devanagari:
कथम् हि त्वद् विहीनो अहम् प्रतियास्यामि ताम् पुरीम् |
तव तात वियोगेन पुत्र शोक आकुलाम् इव
verses.iast:
katham hi tvad vihīno aham pratiyāsyāmi tām purīm |
tava tāta viyogena putra śoka ākulām iva
verses.translation: "How indeed can I return without you to that city, which through separation from you, has been reduced to the state of a mother stricken with grief due to separation from her son"

glosses.meaning: has been reduced to the state of a mother stricken with grief due to separation from her son."

verses.devanagari:
सरामम् अपि तावन् मे रथम् दृष्ट्वा तदा जनः |
विना रामम् रथम् दृष्ट्वा विदीर्येत अपि सा पुरी
verses.iast:
sarāmam api tāvan me ratham dṛṣṭvā tadā janaḥ |
vinā rāmam ratham dṛṣṭvā vidīryeta api sā purī
verses.translation: "By seeing my chariot on that day even with Rama in it, the people were lamenting so much. Now, if they see the chariot without Rama the city of Ayodhya will even be broken asunder."

glosses.meaning: (were lamenting) so much. DR^ishhTvaa = by seeing (now)

verses.devanagari:
दैन्यम् हि नगरी गच्चेद् दृष्ट्वा शून्यम् इमम् रथम् |
सूत अवशेषम् स्वम् सैन्यम् हत वीरम् इव आहवे
verses.iast:
dainyam hi nagarī gacced dṛṣṭvā śūnyam imam ratham |
sūta avaśeṣam svam sainyam hata vīram iva āhave
verses.translation: "The city will be plunged in misery, like an army in which its commander is lost in a combat with the charioteer alone surviving, on seeing this chariot without you."

glosses.meaning: in which its commander has been killed

verses.devanagari:
दूरे अपि निवसन्तम् त्वाम् मानसेन अग्रतः स्थितम् |
चिन्तयन्त्यो अद्य नूनम् त्वाम् निराहाराः कृताः प्रजाः
verses.iast:
dūre api nivasantam tvām mānasena agrataḥ sthitam |
cintayantyo adya nūnam tvām nirāhārāḥ kṛtāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: "Thinking of you, who though residing far away are established foremost in their minds, the people of Ayodhya must have been deprived of their food today."

glosses.meaning: without food. nuunam = It is certain."

verses.devanagari:
दृष्टं तद्धि त्वया राम! यादृशम् त्वत्प्रवासने |
प्रजानाम् सम्कुलम् वृत्तम् त्वच्छोकक्लान्तचेतसाम्
verses.iast:
dṛśhṭaṃ taddhi tvayā rāma! yādṛśam tvatpravāsane |
prajānām samkulam vṛttam tvacchokaklāntacetasām
verses.translation: "The great perplexity that ensued, on the occasion of your exile, among the people (of Ayodhya), whose minds were depressed through grief on your account, was witnessed by you indeed, Oh, Rama!"

glosses.meaning: on the occasion of your exile
whose minds were depressed through grief on your account."

verses.devanagari:
आर्त नादो हि यः पौरैः मुक्तः तत् विप्रवासने |
रथस्थम् माम् निशाम्य एव कुर्युः शत गुणम् ततः
verses.iast:
ārta nādo hi yaḥ pauraiḥ muktaḥ tat vipravāsane |
rathastham mām niśāmya eva kuryuḥ śata guṇam tataḥ
verses.translation: "The cry of distress raised by the citizens (of Ayodhya) will be increased a hundred-fold, when they see me with an empty chariot."

glosses.meaning: at the time of your banishment

verses.devanagari:
अहम् किम् च अपि वक्ष्यामि देवीम् तव सुतः मया |
नीतः असौ मातुल कुलम् सम्तापम् मा कृथाइति
verses.iast:
aham kim ca api vakṣyāmi devīm tava sutaḥ mayā |
nītaḥ asau mātula kulam samtāpam mā kṛthāiti
verses.translation: "Further, shall I say to the queen Kausalya as follows: - �Your son, Rama has been taken by me to the house of his maternal uncle, do not grieve'."

glosses.meaning: "what shall I say further? Deviim = To Kausalya
to the house of his maternal uncle

verses.devanagari:
असत्यम् अपि न एव अहम् ब्रूयाम् वचनम् ईदृशम् |
कथम् अप्रियम् एव अहम् ब्रूयाम् सत्यम् इदम् वचः
verses.iast:
asatyam api na eva aham brūyām vacanam īdṛśam |
katham apriyam eva aham brūyām satyam idam vacaḥ
verses.translation: "I cannot tell such words too which are untrue. How can I tell, �I abandoned your son in the forest', which words are true but unkind?"

verses.devanagari:
मम तावन् नियोगस्थाः त्वद् बन्धु जन वाहिनः |
कथम् रथम् त्वया हीनम् प्रवक्ष्यन्ति हय उत्तमाः
verses.iast:
mama tāvan niyogasthāḥ tvad bandhu jana vāhinaḥ |
katham ratham tvayā hīnam pravakṣyanti haya uttamāḥ
verses.translation: "How will the excellent horses obedient to me, which carried yourself, Sita and Lakshmana, draw the chariot bereft of you?"

glosses.meaning: which carried yourselves and your relatives(Sita and Lakshmana)

verses.devanagari:
तन्न शक्ष्याम्यहम् गन्तुमयोध्याम् त्वदृतेऽनघ |
वनवासानुयानाय मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
tanna śakśyāmyaham gantumayodhyām tvadṛte'nagha |
vanavāsānuyānāya māmanujJṇātumarhasi
verses.translation: "Oh, the faultless Rama! For this reason, I cannot go back to Ayodhya. (Pray) permit me to accompany you to the forest."

glosses.meaning: to Ayodhya. arhasi = You are obliged
to accompany you to the forest."

verses.devanagari:
यदि मे याचमानस्य त्यागम् एव करिष्यसि |
सरथो अग्निम् प्रवेक्ष्यामि त्यक्त मात्रैह त्वया
verses.iast:
yadi me yācamānasya tyāgam eva kariṣyasi |
saratho agnim pravekṣyāmi tyakta mātraiha tvayā
verses.translation: "If you leave me even though I solicit you to take me with you, I shall enter a fire with chariot and all, here itself the moment I am forsaken by you"

verses.devanagari:
भविष्यन्ति वने यानि तपो विघ्न कराणि ते |
रथेन प्रतिबाधिष्ये तानि सत्त्वानि राघव
verses.iast:
bhaviṣyanti vane yāni tapo vighna karāṇi te |
rathena pratibādhiṣye tāni sattvāni rāghava
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! With the help of the chariot, I shall ward off those animals in the forest, which create obstacles to your austerities."

verses.devanagari:
तत् कृतेन मया प्राप्तम् रथ चर्या कृतम् सुखम् |
आशंसे त्वत् कृतेन अहम् वन वास कृतम् सुखम्
verses.iast:
tat kṛtena mayā prāptam ratha caryā kṛtam sukham |
āśaṃse tvat kṛtena aham vana vāsa kṛtam sukham
verses.translation: "The pleasure of driving your chariot has been obtained by me because of you and it is through you that I seek the happiness that comes in dwelling in a forest."

glosses.meaning: by me. TvatkRi^tena = It is through you
that comes in dwelling in a forest."

verses.devanagari:
प्रसीद इच्चामि ते अरण्ये भवितुम् प्रत्यनन्तरः |
प्रीत्या अभिहितम् इच्चामि भव मे पत्यनन्तरः
verses.iast:
prasīda iccāmi te araṇye bhavitum pratyanantaraḥ |
prītyā abhihitam iccāmi bhava me patyanantaraḥ
verses.translation: "Be graceful. I desire to become your close associate in the forest. I wish to hear your loving assent with the words �be my close associate!"

glosses.meaning: in the forest. ichchhaami = I wish(to hear)

verses.devanagari:
इमे चापि हया वीर यदि ते वनवासिनः |
परिचर्याम् करिष्यन्ति प्राप्स्यन्ति परमाम् गतिम्
verses.iast:
ime cāpi hayā vīra yadi te vanavāsinaḥ |
paricaryām kariśhyanti prāpsyanti paramām gatim
verses.translation: "Oh, hero! If these horses too can render service to you, they can attain a supreme abode."

glosses.meaning: If these horses too can do

verses.devanagari:
तव शुश्रूषणम् मूर्ध्ना करिष्यामि वने वसन् |
अयोध्याम् देव लोकम् वा सर्वथा प्रजहाम्य् अहम्
verses.iast:
tava śuśrūṣaṇam mūrdhnā kariṣyāmi vane vasan |
ayodhyām deva lokam vā sarvathā prajahāmy aham
verses.translation: -"By all means, I am leaving for good, Ayodhya or even heaven. Dwelling in the forest, with my head bent low, I shall render service to you."

verses.devanagari:
न हि शक्या प्रवेष्टुम् सा मया अयोध्या त्वया विना |
राज धानी महा इन्द्रस्य यथा दुष्कृत कर्मणा
verses.iast:
na hi śakyā praveṣṭum sā mayā ayodhyā tvayā vinā |
rāja dhānī mahā indrasya yathā duṣkṛta karmaṇā
verses.translation: "As a doer of wicked deeds cannot enter Amaravati, the capital of Devendra, so also I cannot enter Ayodhya without you."

glosses.meaning: by a doer of wicked deeds."

verses.devanagari:
वन वासे क्षयम् प्राप्ते मम एष हि मनो रथः |
यद् अनेन रथेन एव त्वाम् वहेयम् पुरीम् पुनः
verses.iast:
vana vāse kṣayam prāpte mama eṣa hi mano rathaḥ |
yad anena rathena eva tvām vaheyam purīm punaḥ
verses.translation: "This is indeed my desire that after reaching the end of your exile, I may take you back to the city of Ayodhya in this very chariot."

verses.devanagari:
चतुर् दश हि वर्षाणि सहितस्य त्वया वने |
क्षण भूतानि यास्यन्ति शतशः तु ततः अन्यथा
verses.iast:
catur daśa hi varṣāṇi sahitasya tvayā vane |
kṣaṇa bhūtāni yāsyanti śataśaḥ tu tataḥ anyathā
verses.translation: "So long as I am with you together in the forest, fourteen years will slip away momentarily. Otherwise than this, they will multiply a hundred- fold."

verses.devanagari:
भृत्य वत्सल तिष्ठन्तम् भर्तृ पुत्र गते पथि |
भक्तम् भृत्यम् स्थितम् स्थित्याम् त्वम् न माम् हातुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
bhṛtya vatsala tiṣṭhantam bhartṛ putra gate pathi |
bhaktam bhṛtyam sthitam sthityām tvam na mām hātum arhasi
verses.translation: "Oh, prince, who are so fond of your dependents! You ought not abandon me, your devoted servant, established in the path followed by the son of his master and (always)keeping within bounds."

glosses.meaning: followed by the son of his master

verses.devanagari:
एवम् बहु विधम् दीनम् याचमानम् पुनः पुनः |
रामः भृत्य अनुकम्पी तु सुमन्त्रम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
evam bahu vidham dīnam yācamānam punaḥ punaḥ |
rāmaḥ bhṛtya anukampī tu sumantram idam abravīt
verses.translation: Rama, who was compassionate towards his dependents, spoke as follows to Sumantra, who was miserably entreating him again and again in many modes.

glosses.meaning: who was compassionate towards his dependents

verses.devanagari:
जानामि परमाम् भक्तिम् मयि ते भर्तृ वत्सल |
शृणु च अपि यद् अर्थम् त्वाम् प्रेषयामि पुरीम् इतः
verses.iast:
jānāmi paramām bhaktim mayi te bhartṛ vatsala |
śṛṇu ca api yad artham tvām preṣayāmi purīm itaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, charioteer so fond of your master! I know your excellent devotion to me. Hear wherefore I send you from here to the city of Ayodhya."

glosses.itrans: so fond of your master! jaanaami
glosses.iast: so fond of your master! jānāmi
glosses.devanagari: सो fओन्द् ओf योउर् मस्तेर्! जानामि

verses.devanagari:
नगरीम् त्वाम् गतम् दृष्ट्वा जननी मे यवीयसी |
कैकेयी प्रत्ययम् गच्चेद् इति रामः वनम् गतः
verses.iast:
nagarīm tvām gatam dṛṣṭvā jananī me yavīyasī |
kaikeyī pratyayam gacced iti rāmaḥ vanam gataḥ
verses.translation: "Seeing you, returning to Ayodhya, Kaikeyi, my younger mother will get the proof that Rama has gone to the forest."

verses.devanagari:
परितुष्टा हि सा देवि वन वासम् गते मयि |
राजानम् न अतिशन्केत मिथ्या वादी इति धार्मिकम्
verses.iast:
parituṣṭā hi sā devi vana vāsam gate mayi |
rājānam na atiśanketa mithyā vādī iti dhārmikam
verses.translation: "Having completely satisfied, about me having gone to forest, Kaikeyi will leave her strong suspicion that the virtuous king may be a person who speaks untruth."

verses.devanagari:
एष मे प्रथमः कल्पो यद् अम्बा मे यवीयसी |
भरत आरक्षितम् स्फीतम् पुत्र राज्यम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.iast:
eṣa me prathamaḥ kalpo yad ambā me yavīyasī |
bharata ārakṣitam sphītam putra rājyam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: "This is my first priority that my younger mother should get the extensive kingdom, protected by Bharata and thus ruled by her own son."

glosses.meaning: rule to be observed before any other rule

verses.devanagari:
मम प्रिय अर्थम् राज्ञः च सरथः त्वम् पुरीम् व्रज |
संदिष्टः च असि या अनर्थांस् तांस् तान् ब्रूयाः तथा तथा
verses.iast:
mama priya artham rāGYaḥ ca sarathaḥ tvam purīm vraja |
saṃdiṣṭaḥ ca asi yā anarthāṃs tāṃs tān brūyāḥ tathā tathā
verses.translation: "For my pleasure and pleasure of the king, you go along with the chariot to Ayodhya and inform all the matters that you have been asked to tell each in the way you have been asked to do."

verses.devanagari:
इति उक्त्वा वचनम् सूतम् सान्त्वयित्वा पुनः पुनः |
गुहम् वचनम् अक्लीबम् रामः हेतुमद् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
iti uktvā vacanam sūtam sāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ |
guham vacanam aklībam rāmaḥ hetumad abravīt
verses.translation: Having spoken thus to the charioteer, the courageous Rama consoled him again and again. Then, he spoke the following reasoned words to Guha:

verses.devanagari:
नेदानीम् गुह योग्योऽयम् वसो मे सजने वने |
अवश्यम् ह्याश्रमे वासह् कर्तव्यस्तद्गतो विधिः
verses.iast:
nedānīm guha yogyo'yam vaso me sajane vane |
avaśyam hyāśrame vāsah kartavyastadgato vidhiḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Guha! This stay in the inhabited woods is not proper for me. My stay should definitely be in a hermitage. Let an action diverted towards that aim be taken"

glosses.meaning: inhabited with people. na yogyaH = is not proper
in a hermitage. VidhiH = Let the action

verses.devanagari:
सोऽहम् गृहीत्वा नियमम् तपस्विजनभूषणम् |
हितकामः पितुर्भूयः सीताया लक्ष्मणस्य च
जटाः कृत्वा गमिष्यामि न्यग्रोध क्षीरम् आनय |
verses.iast:
so'ham gṛhītvā niyamam tapasvijanabhūśhaṇam |
hitakāmaḥ piturbhūyaḥ sītāyā lakśmaṇasya ca
jaṭāḥ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi nyagrodha kṣīram ānaya |
verses.translation: "I as such, wishing well of my father, Sita as well as Lakshmana and having taken up a discipline to be followed by ascetics, want to proceed further, wearing matted hair. Please bring the latex of a banyan tree."

glosses.meaning: the milk-like exudation (latex) of a banyan tree."

verses.devanagari:
तत् क्षीरम् राज पुत्राय गुहः क्षिप्रम् उपाहरत्
लक्ष्मणस्य आत्मनः चैव रामः तेन अकरोज् जटाः |
verses.iast:
tat kṣīram rāja putrāya guhaḥ kṣipram upāharat
lakṣmaṇasya ātmanaḥ caiva rāmaḥ tena akaroj jaṭāḥ |
verses.translation: Guha immediately brought that latex to the prince. With that, Rama made matted hair to himself and to Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: to the prince. Tena = with that

verses.devanagari:
दीर्घबाहुर्नरव्याघ्रो जटिलत्व मधारयत्
तौ तदा चीर वसनौ जटा मण्डल धारिणौ |
अशोभेताम् ऋषि समौ भ्रातरौ राम रक्ष्मणौ
verses.iast:
dīrghabāhurnaravyāghro jaṭilatva madhārayat
tau tadā cīra vasanau jaṭā maṇḍala dhāriṇau |
aśobhetām ṛṣi samau bhrātarau rāma rakṣmaṇau
verses.translation: Rama, tiger among men who possessed long arms wore the distinguished mark of an ascetic (in the shape of matted hair) . Then, Rama and Lakshmana the brothers clad in the bark of trees and wearing a round mass of matted locks (on their head) looked bright like two ascetic sages.

glosses.meaning: clad in the bark of trees
and wearing a rounded mass of matted locks (on their hair)

verses.devanagari:
ततः वैखानसम् मार्गम् आस्थितः सह लक्ष्मणः |
व्रतम् आदिष्टवान् रामः सहायम् गुहम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ vaikhānasam mārgam āsthitaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ |
vratam ādiṣṭavān rāmaḥ sahāyam guham abravīt
verses.translation: Having adopted the way of a hermit (temporarily) along with Lakshmana, Rama then accepted the vow of an ascetic life and spoke to Guha, his friend as follows:

verses.devanagari:
अप्रमत्तः बले कोशे दुर्गे जन पदे तथा |
भवेथा गुह राज्यम् हि दुरारक्षतमम् मतम्
verses.iast:
apramattaḥ bale kośe durge jana pade tathā |
bhavethā guha rājyam hi durārakṣatamam matam
verses.translation: "Oh, Guha! Remain vigilant in defense, finance, internal security and public relations, for a kingdom is the most difficult one to be protected!"

glosses.meaning: in the case of an army
the people. Matam hi = It is said
is the most difficult one to protect."

verses.devanagari:
ततः तम् समनुज्ञाय गुहम् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दनः |
जगाम तूर्णम् अव्यग्रः सभार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tam samanuGYāya guham ikṣvāku nandanaḥ |
jagāma tūrṇam avyagraḥ sabhāryaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Then Rama, who was a delight to Ikshvaku dynasty, bade farewell to Guha and departed quickly, remaining undistracted, along with his consort and together with Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
स तु दृष्ट्वा नदी तीरे नावम् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दनः |
तितीर्षुः शीघ्रगाम् गन्गाम् इदम् लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa tu dṛṣṭvā nadī tīre nāvam ikṣvāku nandanaḥ |
titīrṣuḥ śīghragām gangām idam lakṣmaṇam abravīt
verses.translation: Seeing the boat on the bank of the river and keen to cross the swift- flowing Ganga, Rama spoke to Lakshmana as follows: -

glosses.meaning: on the bank of the river

verses.devanagari:
आरोह त्वम् नर व्याघ्र स्थिताम् नावम् इमाम् शनैः |
सीताम् च आरोपय अन्वक्षम् परिगृह्य मनस्विनीम्
verses.iast:
āroha tvam nara vyāghra sthitām nāvam imām śanaiḥ |
sītām ca āropaya anvakṣam parigṛhya manasvinīm
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana the tiger among men! You get into the boat stationed here unhurriedly afterwards, having helped Sita the virtuous wife step into it."

glosses.itrans: Lakshmana the tiger among men! Tvam
glosses.iast: Lakśmana the tiger among men! ṭvam
glosses.devanagari: Lअक्श्मन थे तिगेर् अमोन्ग् मेन्! ट्वं

verses.devanagari:
स भ्रातुः शासनम् श्रुत्वा सर्वम् अप्रतिकूलयन् |
आरोप्य मैथिलीम् पूर्वम् आरुरोह आत्मवांस् ततः
verses.iast:
sa bhrātuḥ śāsanam śrutvā sarvam apratikūlayan |
āropya maithilīm pūrvam āruroha ātmavāṃs tataḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the command completely of his elder brother, the prudent Lakshmana, by not counteracting it, made Sita to ascend the boat first and stepped into it afterwards.

glosses.meaning: having made Sita to ascend (the boat)

verses.devanagari:
अथ आरुरोह तेजस्वी स्वयम् लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः |
ततः निषाद अधिपतिर् गुहो ज्ञातीन् अचोदयत्
verses.iast:
atha āruroha tejasvī svayam lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ |
tataḥ niṣāda adhipatir guho GYātīn acodayat
verses.translation: Then, the glorious Rama got into the boat himself. Thereafter, Guha the ruler of Nishadas commanded his kinsfolk to row them across the river.

glosses.meaning: his kinsfolk (to row them across the river).

verses.devanagari:
राघवोऽपि महातेजा नावमारुह्य ताम् ततः |
ब्रह्मवत् क्षत्रवच्चैव जजाप हितमात्मनः
verses.iast:
rāghavo'pi mahātejā nāvamāruhya tām tataḥ |
brahmavat kśatravaccaiva jajāpa hitamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: After ascending the boat, Rama too of mighty splendor then recited a sacred text (daiviim naavam etc) fit for brahmanas and Kshatriyas alike and conducive to his own good.

glosses.meaning: recited (a sacred text Daiviim naavam etc) brahmavat = (fit for) Brahmanas

verses.devanagari:
आचम्य च यथाशास्त्रम् नदीम् ताम् सह सीतया |
प्राणमत्प्रीतिसम्हृष्टो लक्ष्मणश्चामितप्रभः
verses.iast:
ācamya ca yathāśāstram nadīm tām saha sītayā |
prāṇamatprītisamhṛśhṭo lakśmaṇaścāmitaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: Having sipped water as per scriptures and with extreme delight, Rama with Sita made obeisance to that river. Lakshmana, of infinite splendor, followed suit.

verses.devanagari:
अनुज्ञाय सुमन्त्रम् च सबलम् चैव तम् गुहम् |
आस्थाय नावम् रामः तु चोदयाम् आस नाविकान्
verses.iast:
anuGYāya sumantram ca sabalam caiva tam guham |
āsthāya nāvam rāmaḥ tu codayām āsa nāvikān
verses.translation: Bidding farewell to Guha with his army of men and Sumantra, Rama sat on the boat and directed the boatmen to move on.

verses.devanagari:
ततः तैः चोदिता सा नौः कर्ण धार समाहिता |
शुभ स्फ्य वेग अभिहता शीघ्रम् सलिलम् अत्यगात्
verses.iast:
tataḥ taiḥ coditā sā nauḥ karṇa dhāra samāhitā |
śubha sphya vega abhihatā śīghram salilam atyagāt
verses.translation: Propelled by those splendid and vigorous oarsmen, that boat furnished with a pilot, rapidly moved across the water.

glosses.meaning: obeying those splendid and vigorous oarsmen

verses.devanagari:
मध्यम् तु समनुप्राप्य भागीरथ्याः तु अनिन्दिता |
वैदेही प्रान्जलिर् भूत्वा ताम् नदीम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
madhyam tu samanuprāpya bhāgīrathyāḥ tu aninditā |
vaidehī prānjalir bhūtvā tām nadīm idam abravīt
verses.translation: Coming to the middle of Bhagirathi river, the irreproachable Sita with joined palms, spoke as follows to the said river: -

verses.devanagari:
पुत्रः दशरथस्य अयम् महा राजस्य धीमतः |
निदेशम् पालयतु एनम् गन्गे त्वद् अभिरक्षितः
चतुर् दश हि वर्षाणि समग्राणि उष्य कानने |
भ्रात्रा सह मया चैव पुनः प्रत्यागमिष्यति
ततः त्वाम् देवि सुभगे क्षेमेण पुनर् आगता |
यक्ष्ये प्रमुदिता गन्गे सर्व काम समृद्धये
verses.iast:
putraḥ daśarathasya ayam mahā rājasya dhīmataḥ |
nideśam pālayatu enam gange tvad abhirakṣitaḥ
catur daśa hi varṣāṇi samagrāṇi uṣya kānane |
bhrātrā saha mayā caiva punaḥ pratyāgamiṣyati
tataḥ tvām devi subhage kṣemeṇa punar āgatā |
yakṣye pramuditā gange sarva kāma samṛddhaye
verses.translation: "Oh, Ganga! Let Rama, the son of the emperor Dasaratha honor his father's command under your protection! Having dwelled in the forest in full fourteen years, may he return once more to your bank with his brother, Lakshmana and myself! Oh, blessed goddess Ganga! Returning safely, with all my desires fulfilled, I shall worship you with great joy."

glosses.meaning: under your protection! Ushhya = Having dwelled

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् हि त्रिपथगा देवि ब्रह्म लोकम् समीक्षसे |
भार्या च उदधि राजस्य लोके अस्मिन् सम्प्रदृश्यसे
verses.iast:
tvam hi tripathagā devi brahma lokam samīkṣase |
bhāryā ca udadhi rājasya loke asmin sampradṛśyase
verses.translation: You, Oh goddess flowing through three regions (namely heaven, earth and subterranean regions), include in your basin the realm of Brahma (the outermost of the six spheres enveloping the earth) and are vividly seen on this terrestrial plane as a consort of the ocean king."

glosses.meaning: Brahma's realm (the outermost of the six spheres enveloping the earth)

verses.devanagari:
सा त्वाम् देवि नमस्यामि प्रशंसामि च शोभने |
प्राप्त राज्ये नर व्याघ्र शिवेन पुनर् आगते
गवाम् शत सहस्राणि वस्त्राणि अन्नम् च पेशलम् |
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदास्यामि तव प्रिय चिकीर्षया
verses.iast:
sā tvām devi namasyāmi praśaṃsāmi ca śobhane |
prāpta rājye nara vyāghra śivena punar āgate
gavām śata sahasrāṇi vastrāṇi annam ca peśalam |
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyāmi tava priya cikīrṣayā
verses.translation: "Oh, charming goddess! I, Sita, greet you and extol you too. When Rama the tiger among men safely returns and regains his kingdom, I shall give away a lakh of cows, soft clothing and food to brahmanas with intent to please you."

glosses.meaning: when Rama the tiger among men
with an intent to please you."

verses.devanagari:
सुराघटसहस्रेण मांसभूतोदनेन च |
यक्ष्ये त्वाम् प्रयता देवि पुरीम् पुनरुपागता
verses.iast:
surāghaṭasahasreṇa māṃsabhūtodanena ca |
yakśye tvām prayatā devi purīm punarupāgatā
verses.translation: "Oh, goddess! After reaching back the city of Ayodhya, I shall worship you with thousand pots of spirituous liquor and jellied meat with cooked rice well prepared for the solemn rite."

glosses.meaning: with thousand pots of spirituous liquor
and jellied meat with cooked rice

verses.devanagari:
यानि त्वत्तीरवासीनि दैवतानि च सन्ति हि |
तानि सर्वाणि यक्ष्यामि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च
verses.iast:
yāni tvattīravāsīni daivatāni ca santi hi |
tāni sarvāṇi yakśyāmi tīrthānyāyatanāni ca
verses.translation: "I shall worship all deities dwelling on your banks as also sacred spots and sanctuaries."

verses.devanagari:
पुनरेव महाबाउर्मया भ्रात्रा च सम्गतः |
अयोध्याम् वनवासात्तु प्रविशत्वनघोऽनघे
verses.iast:
punareva mahābāurmayā bhrātrā ca samgataḥ |
ayodhyām vanavāsāttu praviśatvanagho'naghe
verses.translation: "Oh, irreproachable goddess! May the sinless Rama (with mighty arms) re-enter Ayodhya again from the forest, along with Lakshmana and myself."

verses.devanagari:
तथा सम्भाषमाणा सा सीता गन्गाम् अनिन्दिता |
दक्षिणा दक्षिणम् तीरम् क्षिप्रम् एव अभ्युपागमत्
verses.iast:
tathā sambhāṣamāṇā sā sītā gangām aninditā |
dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇam tīram kṣipram eva abhyupāgamat
verses.translation: Thus praying to Ganga, the efficient and irreproachable Sita rapidly reached the right bank of the river.

verses.devanagari:
तीरम् तु समनुप्राप्य नावम् हित्वा नर ऋषभः |
प्रातिष्ठत सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या च परम् तपः
verses.iast:
tīram tu samanuprāpya nāvam hitvā nara ṛṣabhaḥ |
prātiṣṭhata saha bhrātrā vaidehyā ca param tapaḥ
verses.translation: Reaching the bank and leaving the boat, Rama the best among men and the chastiser of foes proceeded further along with Lakshmana and Sita.

verses.devanagari:
अथ अब्रवीन् महा बाहुः सुमित्र आनन्द वर्धनम् |
भव सम्रक्षणार्थाय सजने विजनेऽपि वा
verses.iast:
atha abravīn mahā bāhuḥ sumitra ānanda vardhanam |
bhava samrakśaṇārthāya sajane vijane'pi vā
verses.translation: Then, Rama the mighty armed, spoke to Lakshmana (who heightened the joy of Sumitra) as follows:

glosses.itrans: "Be prepared for protecting Sita in the inhabited as well as in uninhabited areas also." W.wM---atha
glosses.iast: "Be prepared for protecting ṣita in the inhabited as vell as in uninhabited areas also." W.vṃ---atha
glosses.devanagari: "Bए प्रेपरेद् fओर् प्रोतेच्तिन्ग् षित इन् थे इन्हबितेद् अस् वेल्ल् अस् इन् उनिन्हबितेद् अरेअस् अल्सो." W.व्ं अथ

glosses.meaning: to Lakshmana (who heightened the joy of Sumitra)
and in the uninhabited areas also."

verses.devanagari:
अवश्यम् रक्षणम् कार्यमदृष्टे विजने वने |
अग्रतः गच्च सौमित्रे सीता त्वाम् अनुगच्चतु
verses.iast:
avaśyam rakśaṇam kāryamadṛśhṭe vijane vane |
agrataḥ gacca saumitre sītā tvām anugaccatu
verses.translation: "Security is an inevitable need in a forest, which has unforeseen dangers and is uninhabited, Oh, Lakshmana! Go in front. Let Sita follow you."

glosses.meaning: in front. Siitaa anugachchhatu = Let Sita follow

verses.devanagari:
पृष्ठतः अहम् गमिष्यामि त्वाम् च सीताम् च पालयन् |
अन्योन्यस्य हि नो रक्षा कर्तव्या पुरुषर्षभ
verses.iast:
pṛṣṭhataḥ aham gamiṣyāmi tvām ca sītām ca pālayan |
anyonyasya hi no rakṣā kartavyā puruṣarṣabha
verses.translation: "I shall proceed in the rear, protecting you and Sita. Oh, jewel among men! We must accord protection here to one another."

verses.devanagari:
न हि तावदतिक्रान्ता सुकरा काचन क्रिया |
अद्य दुःखम् तु वैदेही वनवासस्य वेत्स्यति
verses.iast:
na hi tāvadatikrāntā sukarā kācana kriyā |
adya duḥkham tu vaidehī vanavāsasya vetsyati
verses.translation: "An act which has gone out of hand, whatsoever, cannot indeed be remedied again. Sita will experience the hardship of staying in a forest only from now."

verses.devanagari:
प्रणष्टजनसम्बाधम् क्षेत्रारामविवर्बितम् |
विषमम् च प्रपातम् च वनमद्य प्रवेक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
praṇaśhṭajanasambādham kśetrārāmavivarbitam |
viśhamam ca prapātam ca vanamadya pravekśyati
verses.translation: "Today she will enter the forest, where density of people is not seen, which is utterly devoid of fields and gardens, has a rugged surface and is full of stumbles."

glosses.meaning: when density of people is not seen
which is utterly devoid of fields and gardens

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा रामस्य वचनम् प्रतिस्थे लक्ष्मणोऽग्रतः |
अनन्तरम् च सीताया राघवो रघुनन्दनः
verses.iast:
śrutvā rāmasya vacanam pratisthe lakśmaṇO'grataḥ |
anantaram ca sītāyā rāghavo raghunandhanaḥ
verses.translation: Listening to Rama's words, Lakshmana walked in front. Immediately after Sita, Rama, the delight of Raghu dynasty, advanced.

verses.devanagari:
गतम् तु गन्गा पर पारम् आशु |
रामम् सुमन्त्रः प्रततम् निरीक्ष्य |
अध्व प्रकर्षात् विनिवृत्त दृष्टिर् |
र्मुमोच बाष्पम् व्यथितः तपस्वी
verses.iast:
gatam tu gangā para pāram āśu |
rāmam sumantraḥ pratatam nirīkṣya |
adhva prakarṣāt vinivṛtta dṛṣṭir |
rmumoca bāṣpam vyathitaḥ tapasvī
verses.translation: Constantly gazing at Rama, who reached soon the other bank of Ganga River, the distressed Sumantra, his vision having failed due to the long distance and perturbed as he was, shed tears (of grief over separation from Rama).

glosses.meaning: the other bank of Ganga river
tears (of grief over separation from Rama).

verses.devanagari:
स लोकपालप्रतिमप्रभाववाम् |
स्तीर्त्वा महात्मा वरदो महानदीम् |
ततः समृद्धान् शुभसस्यमालिनः |
क्रमेण वत्सान् मुदितानुपागमत्
verses.iast:
sa lokapālapratimaprabhāvavām |
stīrtvā mahātmā varado mahānadīm |
tataḥ samṛddhān śubhasasyamālinaḥ |
krameṇa vatsān muditānupāgamat
verses.translation: Having crossed the great river, Rama the high-soled, the bestowal of boons, equal in glory with the guardians of spheres, then reached progressively the prosperous and the happy land of Vatsa; which contained rows of beautiful crops.

glosses.meaning: equal in glory with the guardians of spheres
which contained rows of beautiful crops.

verses.devanagari:
तौ तत्र हत्वा चतुरः महा मृगान् |
वराहम् ऋश्यम् पृषतम् महा रुरुम् |
आदाय मेध्यम् त्वरितम् बुभुक्षितौ|
वासाय काले ययतुर् वनः पतिम्
verses.iast:
tau tatra hatvā caturaḥ mahā mṛgān |
varāham ṛśyam pṛṣatam mahā rurum |
ādāya medhyam tvaritam bubhukṣitau |
vāsāya kāle yayatur vanaḥ patim
verses.translation: Having hunted there four deer, namely Varaaha, Rishya, Prisata; and Mahaaruru (the four principal species of deer) and taking quickly the portions that were pure, being hungry as they were, Rama and Lakshmana reached a tree to take rest in the evening.
